name: Fated Night
source:
You are walking late at night through the city's park, in your arm an envelope with documents from today's lectures in uni. - You'd rather be in bed right now - but here you are - on your way to deliver them in your best friend's stead to a fellow student.

As far as you can remember the two of you never interacted before but somehow she seems to remember you...

[From [url=https://elduator.itch.io/fated-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
深夜，你走在城里的公园中，臂弯夹着一个信封，里面装着大学今天上课的资料。你现在更想躺在床上，可还是为了替最好的朋友跑腿，正把资料送给一位同学。

在你的记忆里，你们从未有过交集，她却不知为何似乎还记得你……

（摘自[url=https://elduator.itch.io/fated-night]itch.io[/url]）
